story.text: The Mock Turtle and the Gryphon {DANCE} the Lobster {QUADRILLE} for Alice, solemnly round and round her, treading on her {TOES}. “Will you, won’t you, will you, won’t you, will you join the dance?” Then, in a voice choked with sobs, the Mock Turtle {SINGS} of Beautiful {SOUP}, until a {CRY} is heard in the distance: “The {TRIAL}’s beginning!”
story.caption: The Mock Turtle and the Gryphon
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
